text: We cannot determine whether this asset lost tree cover since 2020. The available Earth-observation data (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021) does not cover this asset for the period in question. Without proper satellite imagery or other observations, there is no evidence to confirm or rule out tree-cover loss. The lack of data means we cannot assess compliance or make any statements about changes in tree cover. Further investigation with updated or alternative data sources would be needed.
